proposal.description: The capture gate is held open while the over-temperature comparator is asserted, so that an OTP the supervisor stops on is sure to be recorded. The gate then stays open after the stop for as long as the board stays hot.
proposal.reason: Suppose the converter has stopped while otp_state is still high. A routine power-down UVLO in that time is recorded, which it should not be. A host read clears the record, but OTP then sets its own bit again and episode_start stamps a new fault_time. In the original, both stay empty.

proposal.description: A host read leaves the UVLO bit in place, as if it were a sticky brown-out status flag that only rst_n clears, while every other cause bit is cleared.
proposal.reason: If a host reads a record that holds UVLO, fault_reg still reads back with bit 1 set after the read. Because the record never looks empty again, a later fault never fires episode_start, and fault_time stays at the 0 the read wrote.
